answer_1.quote: we propose a unique challenge on 'learning from small data': PuzzLing Machines, based on the Linguistic Olympiads... Rosetta Stone puzzles , a.k.a. translation puzzles.

answer_2.quote: we use readily available automatic machine translation measures... The first is the BLEU ) score since it is still the standard metric in MT. We use BLEU-2... we use three additional metrics that operate on the level of word pieces: CharacTER , ChrF  and ChrF++ ... we also measure the average exact match...
